cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
저기요, 저 마나 다 탔는데
물 20개만 주실래요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. High-angle three-quarter shot showing the Night Elf Priest sitting exhausted on minimal grey dungeon flagstones on the left, holding an empty corked glass mana flask with her cleric staff stowed on her back. She looks up pleadingly toward the Human Warlock standing on the right, who turns her head back with a helpful expression and a small red imp sitting at her feet.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
물이요? 사냥하다 남는
멜론 주스 20병 드릴게요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Low-angle medium shot from the left focusing on the Human Warlock on the right beaming earnestly as she holds out several corked green glass flasks of melon juice, with her staff stowed on her back and her red imp tucked under her other arm. The Night Elf Priest leans in slightly from the upper left edge, leaving clean open white space in the bottom-left corner.

equip_effects: 사용 효과: 24초에 걸쳐 총 835.2의 마나가 회복됩니다. 음료를 마시려면 앉아 있어야 합니다.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
아뇨, 그 상점 음료 말고
창조 마법 물 달라고요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Over-the-shoulder close-up from behind the Human Warlock on the right, showing the Night Elf Priest on the left with a tired, deadpan expression. With her staff stowed on her back, she politely pushes back the offered corked green glass melon juice flask with one hand.

Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Wordless front-facing deadpan freeze-frame medium shot. On the right, the Human Warlock freezes in blank, wide-eyed shock clutching a corked green glass melon juice flask, surrounded blatantly by floating purple soul shards and her equally baffled red imp dropping its jaw at her feet. On the left, the Night Elf Priest squints down at the red imp in sudden awkward realization.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
혹시 생석 말씀인가요?
이건 1개밖에 못 뽑는데...
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Side-profile medium two-shot on minimal dungeon flagstones. The Human Warlock on the left, flustered with her staff stowed on her back, earnestly holds up a single glowing green Healthstone gem in her bare hand, while the Night Elf Priest on the right stares silently at the gem with sweat drops.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
멜론 주스도 시원하고 좋은데
흑마법사가 물을 어케 줘요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dynamic tilted medium close-up featuring the Human Warlock in the center foreground slumping forward in exasperated disbelief, hugging her corked green glass melon juice flasks and grumpy red imp with her staff stowed on her back. In the right background, the Night Elf Priest awkwardly turns her face away, hiding her embarrassment.
